name: emby-watchparty
description: A synchronized watch party application for Emby media servers. Vue 3 SPA + FastAPI backend with per-user HLS transcodes, late-joiner voting, in-party admin panel, and drift correction. All streaming is proxied through the container so your Emby server can stay on your internal network. Only boot-essential values are set here; everything else (logging, security, rate limits, late-join vote, static session, force-transcode, etc.) is managed live via the /admin panel and persisted to config.json.

paths.name: Avatar Database
paths.description: Persists the avatars.db SQLite database. Without this mount, every container recreate wipes every member's chosen avatar.

paths.name: Avatar Images
paths.description: Persists uploaded avatar image files. Paired with the Avatar Database mount above.

paths.name: Admin Config (config.json)
paths.description: Persists the runtime admin config (edited via /admin) across container recreates. IMPORTANT: `touch config.json` on the host BEFORE the first start, otherwise Docker silently creates it as an empty DIRECTORY and the backend fails to write.

paths.name: Logs (optional)
paths.description: Optional: persist application logs to disk. Only writes when Log To File is enabled in the /admin panel (default: console-only).

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the emby-watchparty web interface. Must match WATCH_PARTY_PORT below.

variables.name: Emby Server URL
variables.description: Full URL to your Emby server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8096. Reachable from inside this container.

variables.name: Emby API Key
variables.description: Admin Emby API key. Generate one in Emby Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys. Per-user credentials are NOT set here -- users log in from inside the party UI.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Signing key for the party-bound session cookie. Generate ONCE with `openssl rand -hex 32` and leave it -- must persist across restarts and across every uvicorn worker. If left at the default, an ephemeral key is generated at boot with a loud warning; fine for local dev, catastrophic in production (every restart kicks everyone out).

variables.name: Session Cookie Secure
variables.description: When `true`, the session cookie carries the Secure flag so browsers only send it over HTTPS. Set `true` for every deployment behind TLS; leave `false` for local http://localhost dev (setting it true on an http origin locks users out).

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Interface the app listens on inside the container. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces (typical for Docker); rarely needs changing.

variables.name: Container Port
variables.description: Port the app binds inside the container. Must match the container-side of the Web UI Port mapping above.

variables.name: App Prefix
variables.description: URL prefix for reverse-proxy deployments behind a subpath (e.g. /watchparty). Leave empty for root-of-domain deployments. Backend routers, Socket.IO, /assets, and the SPA all honour the prefix at runtime -- no rebuild required.

variables.name: CORS Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated origin allowlist for the Socket.IO server. `*` accepts XHR-poll handshakes from any origin -- convenient for testing but pair with per-IP throttling. Pin to your real origin(s) for a proper deployment, e.g. `https://watchparty.example.com,https://staging.example.com`.

variables.name: Session Expiry (seconds)
variables.description: Session cookie lifetime in seconds. Default 86400 (24 hours).
